implementation.meta: mcq_by_id.json id -> subjectIdx int; subject index 0 (accounting) is falsy-safe via `m == null` checks (5 sites fixed in query-engine)
implementation.ordering: created_at DESC, id ASC — mirrors SQLite ORDER BY; walkRecent iterates recent.json permutation; tie-break matches natural part order (verified: 0 position diffs, tie groups up to 1531 rows)
implementation.fetchRows: group ids by subject; cached parts used from LRU, uncached parts streamed with Set filter (never materialize oversized parts)
implementation.options: options/<subject>.json attached as optionA..D (SQLite JOIN options parity); /api/mcq/:id additionally returns options array [{label,text}]
implementation.related: relatedQuestions via per-subject stream + tag-overlap scoring (LIMIT 5, score DESC) — relByTag equivalent; active-only rows
